reviewed_contracts.result: Append/pop/clear/indexed assignment only query registered-owner absence; they do not cancel from borrowed frames. Gates precede native writes, allocations, refcounts, synchronization, tags and notifiers. Native invalid pop reports before the owner gate; invalid indexed assignment returns false. Indexed slot MAXMAT+1 retains the native successful early no-op.

reviewed_contracts.result: The same append/pop/clear bodies are exported with their existing ID/Main/Material/ReportList/int signatures. FunctionRNA identity selects exactly the three methods; ParameterList input and popped Material pointer output use native lookup/copy conventions. Registration retains FUNC_USE_MAIN, nullable required append, pop index default -1, reports and return. Combined owned dispatch avoids makesrna's later callback-bearing CTX_data_main(C) query. Non-Apple profiling remains false and uses ordinary dispatch.

Python owns target PointerRNA and indexed value copies before cancellation. Method preparation captures active target/incoming/storage before the implicit context Main lookup, then verifies fresh state. With a registered owner, IDMaterials method data must equal owner_id and have no ancestor chain. Initially absent calls requery absence after lookup and refuse a newly registered owner. Context identity/report refusal precedes ordinary indexed false/length or popped return conversion.

Prelookup invalid-pop receipt preserves the exact native Index out of range path using fresh Main membership, numeric address, session UID, type and short count. It does not demand unrelated arrays/material identities for a native error-only path, including UID-zero or malformed arrays. A changed receipt refuses before the native callback.

Capture reconstructs typed data/Material/Library/override identities, arrays, short data count, data users, and the ordered set of sharing Objects with native-width int counts/active indices, physical Object arrays/materials/link bits. It uses numeric membership before dereference and snapshots direct arrays instead of mutating ordinary getters. Foreign Main bypass requires fresh target membership disjoint from G_MAIN; context Main alone is insufficient.

Explicit drains preserve original caller C and MaterialAssignmentOriginal policy. Every successful WM call is followed by G_MAIN and full input recapture before inspecting did_teardown, including a successful absence return after context callbacks. The existing WM original-material recursion barrier rejects nested absence queries and mutation during native cancellation. Both current collection and retained assignment helper follow this ordering.

Actual pinned BKE bodies retain append without a MAXMAT clamp, nullable refcounts, negative pop normalization, null-slot successful pop, final-slot distinct synchronization, and empty clear side effects. MAXMAT is 32766; short count can be 32767 after append. Indexed key32766/count32767 remains native success with BKE early no-op. Dependent Object synchronization runs after drain and before any new Main lock is acquired.

proof_boundaries: Independent source and bounded host-fixture review, not a new native iOS build, packaged IPA, compiled-consumer or device acceptance claim.

Actual tracked pinned material bodies and actual changed RNA/WM/producer source execute in fixtures; native cancellation, Main/context providers, allocation, refcount/freeing, geometry/depsgraph effects and Python conversion remain instrumented boundaries.
No-owner native baseline, including arbitrary context-provider behavior, is preserved; this is not a generic ID lifetime proof. Null G_MAIN conservatively refuses Apple mutation.
256 outer drain attempts do not prove a global reentrancy/callback bound, and refusal does not roll back callback effects.
External native calls, complete exception/global CFG behavior, UIKit and iPad interaction remain outside this review.
